name: Create Hotel
overview: [excited] Let's create a Hotel! Think of this... as adding a new customer. [friendly] We need their contact info, tax IDs, addresses, and key people. Once they're in, we can start billing and ordering. Let's do it!

nodes.label: Hotel Name
nodes.explanation: [casual] First, the Hotel Name. Use the OFFICIAL business name... it shows up on all invoices and orders.
nodes.tips: Use the full official name. You can always search by partial name later.

commonQuestions.question: Can I change the name later?
commonQuestions.answer: Yes, you can edit the hotel details after creation.

nodes.label: Contact Phone
nodes.explanation: [casual] What's their primary phone number? We use this for delivery coordination.

nodes.label: Contact Email
nodes.explanation: [casual] And their main email. Invoices and confirmations go right HERE.
nodes.tips: Use a generic department email rather than a personal one, so it stays active even if staff changes.

nodes.label: Status
nodes.explanation: [curious] Are they ACTIVE? Only active hotels show up for new orders. Set it to INACTIVE if you stop working with them.
nodes.tips: New hotels should always be Active. Use Inactive only when the relationship has ended.

commonQuestions.question: What happens if I set a hotel to Inactive?
commonQuestions.answer: Existing orders and data are preserved, but you cannot create new orders for this hotel. It will not appear in the customer dropdown.

nodes.label: Customer Type
nodes.explanation: [casual] What type of customer is this? Hotel, hospital, resort... this affects billing rules and agreements.
nodes.tips: Choose the type that best matches the business. This affects which product agreements are available.

nodes.label: GSTIN Number
nodes.explanation: [curious] Got their GSTIN? This 15-character code is a MUST for tax compliance and invoices.
nodes.tips: Verify the GSTIN on the government GST portal before entering. An incorrect GSTIN will cause invoice mismatches.

commonQuestions.question: Is GSTIN mandatory?
commonQuestions.answer: It depends on your tax configuration. If your business is GST-registered, you should enter the customer's GSTIN for proper invoicing.

nodes.label: PAN Number
nodes.explanation: [casual] And their PAN number. It's a 10-character code... usually the first part of the GSTIN.

nodes.label: Address Line 1
nodes.explanation: [casual] Now the billing address. This goes on all financial records.

nodes.label: Address Line 2
nodes.explanation: [casual] Add the area or landmark in line two.

nodes.label: City
nodes.explanation: [casual] The city.

nodes.label: State
nodes.explanation: [curious] The state. This is IMPORTANT... it affects the GST calculation for interstate deliveries!
nodes.tips: Make sure the state matches the GSTIN registration state for correct tax calculation.

nodes.label: ZIP Code
nodes.explanation: [casual] The ZIP code.

nodes.label: Country
nodes.explanation: [casual] And the country.

nodes.label: Address Line 1
nodes.explanation: [casual] Now the shipping address! Where do deliveries actually GO? It can be the same as billing.

commonQuestions.question: Is the shipping address the same as billing?
commonQuestions.answer: It can be. Many hotels use the same address for both. If deliveries go to a different entrance or location, enter that address here.

nodes.label: Address Line 2
nodes.explanation: [casual] Line two for the shipping area.

nodes.label: City
nodes.explanation: [casual] The shipping city.

nodes.label: State
nodes.explanation: [casual] The state.

nodes.label: ZIP Code
nodes.explanation: [casual] The ZIP code.

nodes.label: Country
nodes.explanation: [casual] And the country.

nodes.name: Contact Person
nodes.explanation: [excited] Finally, the Contact Persons! These are the people you actually talk to... like the housekeeping head or procurement officer.
nodes.explanationForMultiple: [friendly] Let's add a second contact so you can see how it looks.

children.label: Phone
children.explanation: [casual] Their direct phone... for quick updates or issues.

children.label: Email
children.explanation: [casual] And their email. We can send them order notifications right here.

children.label: Tag
children.explanation: [curious] What's their role? Manager, procurement... this helps your team know exactly WHO to call.

wrapUp: [warm and satisfied] And that's a wrap! [chuckles] We covered basics, taxes, addresses, and contacts. Nothing was saved here... so when you're ready, go add a REAL hotel. You've got this!
description: Walkthrough for creating a new hotel or customer
